item.body:
### Summary

Check whether the legacy-app bug "Refresh must reload the current page, not page 1" exists in SwiftHFR (test on the lots named below) and fix it if so. Found by Bybifok (@moust4ki) in the legacy app.

### Scope

SwiftHFR work (from `docs/LOTS.md` "Issues to open" #6): Acceptance criteria of LOT-082 (#100)/083: current page, content kept while loading, kept on failure

Legacy commit: `246a9c7` (see [ezzz/HFRnow#3](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/3)).

Status in LOTS.md: LOT-082 (#100) half done (#32), LOT-083 (#101) half pending.

### Related lots

LOT-082 (#100)

### Depends on

LOT-083 (#101)

### Credit

Found by Bybifok (@moust4ki); credit the finding in the fix (label `moust4ki aka bybifok finding`). Legacy fix: ezzz/HFRnow#3 (open).

### PRs

- [ezzz/HFRnow#3](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/3) — Bybifok's legacy-app corrections (open, not ours)
- [ezzz/HFRnow#13](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/13) — backlog of the findings in LOTS.md (merged)

### Help wanted

@moust4ki, you found this one: would you like to take it? The work is to check whether the bug exists in SwiftHFR (a test on the lots above) and, if it does, to fix it, with the credit to you. Half written: lists refresh the current page in LOT-082 (#100) (merged); the topic reader half waits for LOT-083 (#101).

To take it, comment `/claim <your session id>` (e.g. `/claim human/moust4ki`) and open a PR into `dev-swift` with `Closes #<this issue>` (AGENTS.md §8, CONTRIBUTING.md). If you would rather not, say so and a maintainer session will pick it up.

**For Bybifok (operator decision, 2026-10-29): your findings are yours while the core is out of tokens.** Label `external: ready` added. Follow `docs/agents/EXTERNAL-AGENTS.md`.

**Scope (check first, likely already covered)**
1. `dev-swift` already has `TopicListModelTests.refreshReloadsTheCurrentPageNotPageOne` and `TopicReaderModelTests.refreshReloadsThePageOnScreenAndKeepsItWhileLoading`, both green in CI.
2. Check that they cover every screen that refreshes: forum and topic lists, favourites, the reader, and the tab-bar screens of #303 once it lands. Add a test for any screen that is missing.
3. If everything is covered, comment the evidence (test names, `dev-swift` sha) and close with `Closes #107` in a tests-only PR. A plain comment is enough if nothing needs adding; the maintainer then closes the issue.
4. App code: CI builds and tests it; no Mac needed.

**Adversarial review (if there is a PR)**
- Reviewer model ≠ author model.
- The reviewer gets only: the diff, the PR's metadata lines, the LOT-082 and LOT-083 specs, AGENTS.md and LESSONS.md.
- It must check that each new test fails when refresh reloads page 1.
- Verdict format: EXTERNAL-AGENTS §7.

Credit: Bybifok's finding.

comments.body:
Coverage check per the scope above (ext/bybifok-opus-1, Opus 5.5), on `dev-swift` at `d25de46` (after #303). **Every screen that refreshes is covered; nothing needs adding, so no PR.**

| Screen | Refresh entry | Test proving "current page, not page 1" (or why page 1 is right) |
|---|---|---|
| Forum list (home, Catégories tab) | `ForumListModel.reload()` (`ForumListView.swift:33`) | Single page by nature. `ForumListModelTests.aFailedReloadKeepsTheForumList` keeps the content on failure. |
| Forum topic list (Catégories, sidebar) | `TopicListModel.refresh()` → `load(page: currentPage)` (`TopicListModel.swift:94`, `TopicListView.swift:33,65`) | `TopicListModelTests.refreshReloadsTheCurrentPageNotPageOne` (requests `1, 2, 3, 3`), `.refreshKeepsTheRowsWhenItFails` |
| Sub-forum list | same model, `.subforum` source | `TopicListModelTests.aSubforumPagesThroughItsOwnLinkAndRefreshesTheCurrentPage` (`…:1, …:2, …:2`) |
| Favourites and flags (Favoris tab) | same model, `.favorites` / `.flagged` sources | Not paged (`forum1f.php`), so page 1 is the only page. Covered by `TopicListModelTests.flagsLoadTheFlaggedFilterAndAreNotPaged` and `.flagsAndFavouritesRefreshWhenTheyReappearKeepingRows`. |
| Topic reader | `TopicReaderModel.refresh()` (`TopicReaderView.swift:41,78`) | `TopicReaderModelTests.refreshReloadsThePageOnScreenAndKeepsItWhileLoading`, `.aFailedRefreshKeepsTheContentAndReportsTheError`, `.thePageServedWinsOverThePageAsked` |
| Messages tab | placeholder on `dev-swift` (`MessagesPlaceholderView`) | The MP list is #307, not merged yet. Its diff already brings `pagingMovesByOneAndRefreshReloadsThePageOnScreen`, `appearingAgainRefreshesTheCurrentPage` and `aFailedRefreshKeepsTheRowsAndRetryAsksForTheSamePage`. |
| Plus tab | settings only | No list to refresh. |

All the tab-bar and sidebar list screens get their model from one factory (`NavigationModel.swift:53`), so they share `TopicListModel.refresh()` and its tests.

The maintainer can close this issue on this evidence. Credit: Bybifok's finding.
